property_summary: For any caller and any address passed to SetLogFile, calling SetLogFile successfully sets the Log field and returns (does not permanently lock the contract); the mutant that never clears the reentrancy lock can make subsequent guarded calls revert (i.e., SetLogFile succeeds once but then guarded functions always fail), so the invariant that SetLogFile can be called twice by the same caller (or that a second guarded call still succeeds) is violated by the mutant.
change_summary: Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier to remove setting locked_ back to false after the function body, leaving locked_ permanently true once a guarded function is called.
